# A kick spark: a small four-pointed star of two crossed slabs, unlit yellow.
new
material new Spark --base-color 1.0000 0.9608 0.2510 --emission 1.0000 0.9608 0.2510 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name A --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.36 0.08 0.1
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name B --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.1 0.08 0.36
apply --scale
select A B
active A
join
material assign Spark
select all
shade flat
export spark.glb
